book.name: Yohana
book.title: Amangʼana amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Yohana

content: Yeesu araryookibhwa
Orusiku rwo okutaanga rwo obhutuuro,
etabhoori zuri, Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara akagya kumbiihira ya Yeesu. Akabhona eriigina rihuungwiirwe okurwa mukiseku kye embiihira.

Ambe, akaryaara harya, akagya ku Simooni Petero na kumwaanamweega wuno Yeesu yaamuseegiri. Akabhabhuurira, “Abhaatu bhakiruusiryeho ekituundu kyo Omukuru weetu mumbiihira, kweeki tutamenyiri hano bhakituuriri!”
Petero no omwaanamweega owuundi wurya bhakatanura, bhakeerekera kumbiihira.
Bhoosi bhabhiri bhaari bhararyaara, nawe omwaanamweega wurya owuundi akaryaara kumuhita Petero no okukaangata kuhika kumbiihira.
Akiihiinya, akasoomya mumbiihira, akayirora engibho ndabhu yino bhaamubhiikiirimu Yeesu, nawe ataasikiiri muusi.
Ambe, Simooni Petero akamutuna, akahika harya, akasikira mumbiihira no okuyibhona engibho ndabhu yino bhaamubhiikirimu Yeesu.
Kweeki akakibhona ne ekitaambaara kino bhaamubhoheeri Yeesu kumutwe. Ekitaambaara kiyo kitaari hamwe ne engibho eyiindi, nawe kikakunywa no okutuurwa embarika.
Ambe, omwaanamweega owuundi wurya, wuno akakaangata kuhika harya, neewe akasikira mumbiihira. Akarora no okwiikirirya.
Bhaari bhakyaari okumenya Amakaamo Amahoreeru gano garabhuga kubha, Yeesu ereenderwa aryooke okurwa mubhaku.
Ambe, abhaanabheega bharya bhakagya owaabhu.
Yeesu aramutuukira Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara
Nawe Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara akasaaga no okwiimeerera igutu mumbiihira, yaari ararira. Hano yaari ararira, akiihiinya no okusoomya mumbiihira,

akabharora bhamaraika bhabhiri bhano bhiibhohiri emyeenda emirabhu. Bhakiikara hano bhaari bhahiindiirye ekituundu kya Yeesu. Maraika wumwe akiikara orubhaara rwa kumutwe, owuundi akiikara orubhaara rwa mumaguru.
Bhamaraika bharya bhakamubhuurya, “Ee maayi, kwaki orarira?” Neewe akabhakyoora, “Abhaatu bhakiruusiryeho ekituundu kyo Omukuru waane, kweeki nitamenyiri hano bhakituuriri!”
Hano Mariamu yabhugiri amangʼana gayo, akiikibhuka, akamurora Yeesu yiimeereeri haryaharya, nawe Mariamu ataamumenyiri.

Yeesu akamubhuurya, “Ee maayi, kwaki orarira? Mbe, oramukomya weewi?” Mariamu yiiseegiri kubha omuutu wurya yaari omuhokya wo omuguundu, kweego akamukyoora, “Ee taata, eraabhe naawe oruusiryeho ekituundu kyaaye, mbuurira hano okituuriri, neenye ndagya kukigega.”
Yeesu akamubhirikira eriina ryaaye, “Mariamu!” Ambe Mariamu akiikibhuka, akamurora Yeesu, akabhuga mukigaambo kye Ekieburania, “Raboni!” Obhugazuro bhwaku ni Omweegya.
Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Otaanigwaata, kwo okubha nkyaari kugya mwiisaaro ku Taata. Ambe, noogye obhabhuurire abhahiiri bhaane,
kubha ndagya mwiisaaro ku Taata, neewe ni Wuuso weenyu, ku Taatabhugya waane, neewe ni Taatabhugya weenyu.”
Ambe Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara akagya kubhaanabheega bha Yeesu, akabhabhuurira amangʼana gayo, “Enye nimuruuzi Omukuru!” Kyaamwe, akabhakeerenerya goosi gano Yeesu amuswaagirye.
Yeesu arabhahwaarukira abhaanabheega bhaaye

Hano yahikiri engoroobha orusiku rurya rwo okutaanga rwo obhutuuro, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakiikumania munyuumba yimwe no okwiigara ebhiseku, kwo okubha bhaari bharoobhoha abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi. Kituukiro Yeesu akahwaaruka no okwiimeerera gati waabhu, akabhabhuurira, “Omureembe gubhe neemwe.”
Kyaamwe, akabheerekya amabhoko gaaye no orubharu rwaaye. Hano abhaanabheega bhamuruuzi Omukuru, bhakazomererwa bhukongʼu.
Yeesu akabhabhuurira kweeki, “Omureembe gubhe neemwe. Kyeego Taata akaantuma enye, egoego na neenye ndabhatumania emwe.”
Okumara, akabhahuutira omwiika, akabhabhuurira, “Musuungʼaane Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Eraabhe murabhaabhira abhaatu ebhibhi bhyaabhu, Taatabhugya neewe arabhaabhira ebhibhi bhyaabhu. Eraabhe mutakubhaabhira, Taatabhugya woosi atakubhaabhira.”
Yeesu aramutuukira Tomaso
Omwaanamweega wumwe mubhaanabheega bha Yeesu, eriina ryaaye Tomaso, wuno bhaamubhirikiiri Mbasa, ataari hamwe na abhaanabheega abhaandi hano Yeesu yabhahwaarukiiri.

Ambe, abhaanabheega abhaandi bharya bhakamubhuurira, “Etwe tumuruuzi Omukuru!” Nawe ewe akabhakyoora, “Enye nitakunagya okwiikirirya gayo eraabhe nikyaari kurora hiinga eziikoru zye emisumaari mumabhoko gaaye no okutuura ekyaara kyaane muziikoru ziyo, no okutuura okubhoko kwaane murubharu rwaaye.”

Hano eziisiku inyaanye zyahitiri, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakiikumania hamwe kweeki munyuumba. Orusiku ruyo, Tomaso neewe yaari hamwe nabho. Ebhiseku bhyaari bhiigeeri, nawe, Yeesu akarorekana mwaasi, akiimeerera gatigati waabhu, akabhakeerya, “Omureembe gubhe neemwe.”

Ambe, Yeesu akamubhuurira Tomaso, “Ee Tomaso, nawuuze onikunieku ne ekyaara ekyaazo hano, ogarore amabhoko gaane. Kweeki, onigwaateku no okubhoko kwaazo murubharu rwaane. Otabha no obhwiitiimaati, nawe wiikirirye.”
Tomaso akamukyoora, “Omukuru waane na Taatabhugya waane!”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Wiikiriirye kwo okubha onduuzi. Bhatweereerwe ebhite bhano bhaniikiriirye yiingabha bhakyaari kuundora.”
Obhureengererya mukitabhu kino
Yeesu akakora ebhyeerekenio ebhiindi bhyaaru bhino abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakabhirora, na bhino bhitaakaamirwe mukitabhu kino.

Nawe ebhyeerekenio bhino bhiri mukitabhu kino bhikaamirwe okubha emwe mwiikirirye Yeesu niwe Masiya, Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, no okubha kwo okumwiikirirya, mubhone obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego kuriina ryaaye.

footnotes.text: Orusiku rwo okutaanga rwo obhutuuro ni Jumapiri.
Abhahiiri bhaane, obhugazuro bhwaku ni bhaanabheega bhaane.
